backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining asset, portfolio, and user profile types with access‑controlled queries and updates for profiles, holdings, and asset search.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing files, components, and requirements related to diagnosing a canister deployment failure.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of prewritten summaries for all major frontend files, components, hooks, and utilities.
Explains the deployment failure caused by a missing backend method in the Candid interface and outlines verification steps after fixing it.
frontend/docs/rebuild-checklist.md: Checklist for performing a clean frontend rebuild after backend interface changes or related deployment errors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point loading the root React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, Internet Identity initialization, theme provider, and wraps authenticated routes with AuthGate.
frontend/src/components/assets/AssetSear: Asset search component providing live filtered results and selectable asset entries.
frontend/src/components/assets/MarketTyp: Dropdown selector mapping MarketType enum values to human‑readable labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication gate that shows login, triggers profile setup when needed, and renders protected content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginPrompt: Landing page prompting users to sign in via Internet Identity and showcasing key platform features.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Empty file placeholder for a dashboard hero component.
Layout wrapper providing header, navigation, theme toggle, logout handling, and page structure.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/AddHol: Form to add a new portfolio holding with validation, submission logic, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Holdin: Displays a table of user holdings with asset details, amounts, and purchase info.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Dialog for setting the user's display name during initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/theme/ThemeToggl: Dropdown button allowing users to switch between light, dark, and system themes.
frontend/src/data/assetCatalog.ts: Static catalog of crypto, stock, commodity, and fiat assets used for search and selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddHolding.ts: Mutation hook to add a new holding and invalidate the portfolio cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useAssetSearch.ts: Filters assets from the catalog by search term and market type using memoization.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and exposes login, logout, and status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolio.ts: Fetches the user's portfolio via React Query using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePriceRefreshPlaceh: Sets up an interval placeholder for future periodic price-refresh logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theming variables, and light/dark mode color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAssetPage.tsx: UI flow for selecting an asset and adding a holding to the portfolio.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user's portfolio, handles empty-state UI, and integrates placeholder price-refresh logic.
frontend/src/utils/assetSearch.ts: Provides case‑insensitive asset search by ticker or name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins using CSS variables.
project_state.json: Defines project state metadata, core summary, and a list of implemented features with IDs, descriptions, synonyms, and versioning. Serves as a structured record of the app’s existing frontend and backend capabilities for build planning.
